notes: Focused planning and expanded Diag: new guided/proof drafts request one feature at a time; Foundry assigns sequential dependencies, feature references and ready HTTP prefixes before full proposal review. Saved drafts resume by exact request identity. Impossible early checkpoints are rejected at outline time; each compiled stage stops after six invalid proposals while provider outages use the separate job allowance. Diag includes rule codes, safe candidate shapes, draft progress and retained attempt metrics, with up to 25 detailed projects, 4,000 history events per project and 20,000 recorder events. Limits, unknowns and omissions are explicit. Original prompts, source, credentials and free-text model logs remain excluded. Approved projects, frozen checks, cloud/execution consent and rollback are preserved. Fixture tests do not establish live-model quality or Windows GPU performance.
